purpose: Fixed experiment slice for all Cruise Line optimization experiments. The full verified manifest (eval/manifest.json) holds 20 PRs; this slice is the budget-controlled subset used IDENTICALLY by every experiment (baseline, E1 model sweep, E2 effort sweep, E3 prompt variants) so all comparisons are apples-to-apples.
manifest: eval/manifest.json (20 PRs, 148 ground-truth issues, verified: clone+head-fetch+diff)

measured_cost_anchor.anthropic/claude-opus-5.5@high: ~$0.20-0.25 per PR on small diffs (6 turns)
measured_cost_anchor.note: A 20-PR opus baseline would cost ~$4 alone, so the experiment slice is capped at 4 PRs.

selection_rule: One PR per repo where possible, maximising ground-truth issues per diff line (cheapest signal), within the <=20 files / <=600 lines constraint.
